projects.title: Hate Speech Recognition in Roman Urdu
projects.description: Built an NLP model to detect and classify hate speech in Roman Urdu text. Uses text preprocessing, TF-IDF vectorization, and machine learning classifiers to identify harmful content with high accuracy.

projects.title: Fake News Detection
projects.description: Developed a machine learning system to distinguish fake news from real news articles using natural language processing and classification algorithms. Trained on a labeled news dataset.

projects.title: Handwritten Digit Recognition
projects.description: Implemented a CNN-based deep learning model to recognize handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset with over 98% accuracy. Includes a frontend interface for real-time digit drawing and prediction.

projects.title: Customer Segmentation
projects.description: Applied K-Means and hierarchical clustering to segment customers based on purchasing behavior, demographics, and engagement patterns. Provides actionable insights for targeted marketing.

projects.title: Diabetes Predictor
projects.description: Predictive machine learning model that assesses diabetes risk based on health parameters like glucose level, BMI, age, and blood pressure. Includes an interactive Streamlit frontend.

projects.title: Credit Scoring Model
projects.description: Financial ML model that evaluates creditworthiness and predicts loan default risk. Uses feature engineering, logistic regression, and ensemble methods on financial transaction data.

projects.title: TutorConnect-Pakistan
projects.description: Full-stack AI-powered platform connecting students with qualified tutors across Pakistan. Features smart tutor matching, scheduling, and an integrated RAG-based chatbot for academic support.
